title: Office hours and holidays
text: The office is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM. Company holidays include Diwali, Holi, Independence Day and Republic Day. Employees are notified of the annual holiday calendar every January.

title: Visitor registration
text: All visitors must register at the front desk and wear a visitor badge at all times. Visitors must be escorted by an employee in all areas beyond the lobby.

title: Public product FAQ
text: Our database product supports vector search, SQL and JSON in a single engine. Documentation and tutorials are available on the public website. Community support is offered through forums.

title: Careers and internships
text: We offer summer internships for students in computer science. Applications open in January. Selected interns work with a mentor on a real project for eight weeks.

title: Open source contribution guide
text: External contributors can submit pull requests on our public repositories. Every pull request needs a description, tests and a signed contributor agreement.

title: Brand and logo usage
text: The company logo may not be altered or recoloured. Partners must use the approved logo files and keep clear space equal to the logo height.

title: Support channels
text: Customers can open a ticket through the support portal or call the helpline. Severity 1 tickets get a first response within one hour, severity 2 within four hours.

title: Event participation policy
text: Employees may speak at public conferences after approval from their manager. Slides must not contain customer names or unreleased product plans.

title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval. A secure VPN connection is mandatory. Company laptops must not be used on public Wi-Fi without the VPN.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Expenses must be submitted within 30 days with receipts. Travel above 500 dollars needs prior approval from the department head. Meals are reimbursed up to a daily limit.

title: Password and MFA standard
text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters and rotated every 180 days. Multi-factor authentication is required for all internal systems and the VPN. Shared accounts are forbidden.

title: Code review standard
text: Every change needs one approving review from a code owner. Reviewers check correctness, tests, performance impact and security. Large changes should be split into smaller pull requests.

title: Database backup runbook
text: Full backups run nightly at 2 AM and incremental backups every four hours. Backups are retained for 35 days. Restore tests are performed monthly and results are logged in the operations wiki.

title: On-call rotation
text: On-call engineers rotate weekly. The primary responder acknowledges pages within 10 minutes. If there is no acknowledgement the page escalates to the secondary responder and then the manager.

title: Release process
text: Releases ship every second Tuesday. A release candidate must pass regression tests and a performance gate. Hotfixes follow a shortened process but still need two approvals.

title: Vendor onboarding
text: New vendors must complete a security questionnaire and sign a data processing agreement. Procurement checks financial health before the first purchase order is issued.

title: Incident severity definitions
text: Severity 1 means a full outage or data loss risk for customers. Severity 2 means major degradation. Severity 3 means a minor issue with a workaround. Severity 1 incidents require an incident commander.

title: Learning budget
text: Each employee has an annual learning budget for courses, books and certifications. Unused budget does not roll over. Requests are approved by the manager.

title: Incident 2026-041: storage failover
text: On 12 March a storage controller failed and the cluster failed over to the standby after 7 minutes. Root cause was a firmware bug. Customer impact was limited to read-only mode for the affected tenants. Firmware was patched on all nodes.

title: Security incident: phished credentials
text: An employee entered credentials on a phishing page. The account was used for a login from an unusual location. The session was revoked within 20 minutes, the password reset, and no data access was found in the audit logs.

title: Executive compensation bands
text: Compensation bands for director level and above are reviewed every year by the compensation committee. Bonus pools are set as a percentage of operating profit. Details are confidential to the committee.

title: Acquisition target shortlist
text: The strategy team shortlisted three small analytics companies for a possible acquisition. Due diligence is scheduled for next quarter. Names and valuation ranges must not be shared outside the deal team.

title: Penetration test findings
text: The annual penetration test found two high severity issues: an exposed admin endpoint and weak rate limiting on the login API. Both have owners and a fix deadline of 30 days. Retest is scheduled after fixes.

title: Unreleased roadmap: vector features
text: The next major release plans hybrid keyword and vector search, smaller vector indexes through quantization, and faster index builds. Launch dates are internal and must not be shared with customers.

title: Layoff contingency plan
text: If revenue targets are missed, a contingency plan covers a hiring freeze first, then travel cuts, and only then workforce reduction. This plan is known only to the leadership team.

title: Customer data breach playbook
text: If customer data exposure is suspected, legal and the security lead must be notified within one hour. Regulators are notified within 72 hours where required. Customers are informed after the scope is confirmed.

title: Database encryption key rotation
text: Master encryption keys are rotated every 90 days by two operators using split knowledge. Rotation is performed in a maintenance window and verified by restoring from a fresh backup.

title: Quarterly financial forecast
text: The forecast expects revenue growth of eight percent next quarter driven by cloud subscriptions. Margins are expected to dip slightly because of data center expansion costs.

title: Data retention policy
text: Customer support tickets are retained for three years. Application logs are retained for 90 days. Personal data is deleted on request within 30 days unless a legal hold applies.

title: Accessibility statement
text: We aim to make our products usable with screen readers and keyboard navigation. Accessibility issues can be reported through the support portal and are triaged as normal tickets.
